notes: Guide and controller fixes for games. The guide can no longer leave a game frozen in front (GTA V: guide, Windows key and controller all seemed dead until Alt+Tab). The launcher no longer reads the controller or pulls the screen back while a game is in front, and a game handed the screen back really gets it (Fortnite). Controller-as-mouse is off while an anti-cheat game runs, and leftover virtual controllers are removed when a game starts.
